  1. S3 and air-gapped

S3 and air-gapped

Serving models from object storage, and running in clusters without internet access.

S3 credentials 

apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: s3-credentials
  namespace: models
  annotations:
    serving.kserve.io/s3-endpoint: s3.amazonaws.com
    serving.kserve.io/s3-usehttps: "1"
    serving.kserve.io/s3-region: eu-west-1
type: Opaque
stringData:
  AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: "replace-me"
  AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: "replace-me"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: s3-sa
  namespace: models
secrets:
  - name: s3-credentials

namespace: models

hfSecret:
  enabled: false

serviceAccount:
  enabled: false

modelDefaults:
  runtime: kserve-sklearnserver
  modelFormat: sklearn
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: "1"
      memory: 2Gi
    limits:
      cpu: "2"
      memory: 4Gi

models:
  - name: fraud-detector
    storageUri: s3://models/fraud/v3
    serviceAccountName: s3-sa

  - name: demand-forecast
    runtime: kserve-xgbserver
    modelFormat: xgboost
    storageUri: s3://models/demand/v7
    serviceAccountName: s3-sa

MinIO and S3-compatible storage 

  annotations:
    serving.kserve.io/s3-endpoint: minio.storage.svc.cluster.local:9000
    serving.kserve.io/s3-usehttps: "0"
    serving.kserve.io/s3-region: us-east-1

Cluster-wide defaults:

kserve-resources:
  kserve:
    storage:
      s3:
        endpoint: minio.storage.svc.cluster.local:9000
        useHttps: "0"
        region: us-east-1

Cloud identity instead of keys

Avoid static credentials where possible:

apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: s3-sa
  namespace: models
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/model-reader

No Secret is needed; the pod assumes the role.

Mirroring a Hugging Face model to S3

Run once from a machine with internet access:

pip install huggingface_hub
export HF_TOKEN="hf_replace_me"

python - <<'PY'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download(
    "meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct",
    local_dir="./llama-3.1-8b",
    local_dir_use_symlinks=False,
)
PY

aws s3 sync ./llama-3.1-8b s3://models/llm/llama-3.1-8b

Then serve it without any Hugging Face access:

llmInferenceServices:
  - name: llama-8b
    model:
      uri: s3://models/llm/llama-3.1-8b
    resources:
      limits:
        cpu: "8"
        memory: 32Gi
        nvidia.com/gpu: "1"

Check the model license before copying weights into internal storage.

Fully air-gapped clusters

Four things must come from inside the network:

Item Approach
Chart Push to an internal OCI registry
Dependencies Mirror the seven KServe charts
Container images Mirror controller and runtime images
Model weights Copy into S3 or a PVC

Mirror the chart and dependencies 

helm dependency build helm-charts/model-serving
helm package helm-charts/model-serving

helm registry login registry.internal.example.com
helm push model-serving-0.1.0.tgz oci://registry.internal.example.com/charts

The packaged archive embeds the dependency charts, so the internal cluster needs no access to ghcr.io.

Mirror the images 

for image in \
  kserve/kserve-controller:v0.20.0 \
  kserve/storage-initializer:v0.20.0 \
  kserve/llmisvc-controller:v0.20.0 \
  kserve/sklearnserver:v0.20.0 \
  kserve/huggingfaceserver:v0.20.0 \
  vllm/vllm-openai:v0.11.0 \
  openvino/model_server:2026.3
do
  skopeo copy "docker://docker.io/$image" \
    "docker://registry.internal.example.com/mirror/$image"
done

List exactly which images your configuration needs:

helm template model-serving helm-charts/model-serving -f values.yaml \
  | grep -oE 'image: .*' | sort -u

Point the chart at the mirror 

namespace: models

hfSecret:
  enabled: false

kserve-resources:
  kserve:
    controller:
      image: registry.internal.example.com/mirror/kserve/kserve-controller
      tag: v0.20.0
      imagePullSecrets:
        - name: registry-credentials
    storage:
      image: registry.internal.example.com/mirror/kserve/storage-initializer
      tag: v0.20.0

kserve-llmisvc-resources:
  kserve:
    createSharedResources: false
    llmisvc:
      controller:
        image: registry.internal.example.com/mirror/kserve/llmisvc-controller
        tag: v0.20.0

kserve-runtime-configs:
  kserve:
    servingruntime:
      enabled: true
      sklearnserver:
        image: registry.internal.example.com/mirror/kserve/sklearnserver
        tag: v0.20.0
      huggingfaceserver:
        image: registry.internal.example.com/mirror/kserve/huggingfaceserver
        tag: v0.20.0
      vllmserver:
        image: registry.internal.example.com/mirror/vllm/vllm-openai
        tag: v0.11.0

clusterServingRuntimes:
  openVINO:
    image: registry.internal.example.com/mirror/openvino/model_server:2026.3
  vllmCPU:
    enabled: false

llmDefaults:
  image: registry.internal.example.com/mirror/vllm/vllm-openai:v0.11.0

models:
  - name: fraud-detector
    runtime: kserve-sklearnserver
    modelFormat: sklearn
    storageUri: s3://models/fraud/v3
    serviceAccountName: s3-sa

Install from the internal registry:

helm upgrade --install model-serving \
  oci://registry.internal.example.com/charts/model-serving \
  --version 0.1.0 \
  --namespace kserve --create-namespace \
  -f airgap-values.yaml

Block accidental egress 

models:
  - name: offline-model
    runtime: kserve-huggingfaceserver
    modelFormat: huggingface
    storageUri: s3://models/transformers/classifier
    serviceAccountName: s3-sa
    env:
      - name: TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE
        value: "1"
      - name: HF_HUB_OFFLINE
        value: "1"

PVC instead of object storage

See Storage URIs for populating a shared volume.

models:
  - name: cached-llm
    runtime: kserve-vllmserver
    modelFormat: huggingface
    storageUri: pvc://model-store/llama-3.1-8b

Verify 

kubectl logs -n models <pod> -c storage-initializer --tail=50
kubectl get inferenceservice -n models
Message Cause Fix
AccessDenied Wrong credentials or policy Check the Secret and bucket policy
NoSuchBucket Wrong bucket or region Verify the URI and region annotation
connection refused Endpoint unreachable Check the endpoint annotation and network policy
ImagePullBackOff Image not mirrored Mirror it and add the pull secret
x509: certificate signed by unknown authority Internal CA not trusted Set caBundleConfigMapName
